recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. Future stale entries in resourceguide.html should be handled by targeted Jira issues rather than reopening this broad 2015 completion request.
issue_request: FHIR-7477 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request from the 2015 May ballot, related to the Patient artifact and resourceguide.html section 3.1, asking that the Guide to Resources be completed.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-7477, but August 2015 resourceguide history shows the placeholder being replaced and expanded: commit 014e9d175437d999b5090e29b7488198cb5e9263 added substantive resource guide content, and commits 7524d34dddf437435b8624f9ebf4a180ec80e42f and bb5e3f2a9fcb50aecda21994cda00fdc6981b0c8 overhauled W5 categorization and drafted the common-concepts/resource guide content.
additional_context: source/resourceguide.html is in current build scope through publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml and is linked from current documentation/module/resource-list pages. Later Published/Persuasive with Modification issue FHIR-13042 removed the old Resource Classification detail and replaced it with a Patterns section pointing to Modules and Workflow Patterns, so the current narrower page is intentional later scope rather than unfinished FHIR-7477 work. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already has an active Guide to Resources page with common concept mappings and Resource Patterns links, and adding broad new guide prose would be speculative and could conflict with the later FHIR-13042 decision not to maintain the old detailed classification content.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue that removed the old Resource Classification section and replaced it with pattern links, constraining how FHIR-7477 should be interpreted now.
